---
title: "Multispecies and mixed fisheries"
subtitle: "Workstream 1: multispecies MSY, gear interactions and effort allocation"
---

Many fisheries in the programme's regions are multispecies trawl and multigear fisheries, where single-stock reference points cannot all be achieved at once. This branch collects methods for multispecies MSY and mixed approaches, gear interactions, and effort allocation and fleet capacity.

| Tool | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [mmsyFM](mmsyfm.qmd) | Fleet model for mixed fisheries: safeguarded multispecies MSY, effort and closure rules tested under uncertainty; Shiny app for workshops | Draft |

mmsyFM needs stock productivity and status from single-stock assessments (e.g. [SPiCT](../biomass-dynamic/spict.qmd) or [JABBA](../biomass-dynamic/jabba.qmd)) of the main stocks, and builds on the fleet-targeting logic of [cpueTargeting](../../data-tools/cpuetargeting.qmd).
